# MURYA

> MURYA is a verified INEC civic information platform for Bauchi State. Provides trusted information in Hausa, Fulfulde and English. Features voice reporting, LGA INEC offices verification, and citizen engagement.

## What is MURYA
- Name: MURYA means VOICE in Hausa
- Purpose: Connect citizens to verified INEC services and civic info
- Languages: Hausa, Fulfulde, English
- Coverage: All 20 LGAs of Bauchi State

## Features
- Voice Reporting (Hausa Voice)
- Verified INEC Information (Shield check)
- Voting & Civic Engagement
- LGA offices-based verification
